en.headline: MTR halts Tung Chung East works after new brick wall toppled
en.dek: A worker pushing a loaded pallet jack knocked down a wall started that afternoon, sending bricks to a lower floor; nobody was hurt, the corporation said.
body: The MTR Corporation said works in part of the unfinished Tung Chung East Station on the Tung Chung Line Extension were stopped after a newly started brick wall was knocked down on Saturday afternoon. The operator said nobody was injured.

According to the MTR, the station contractor reported that at about 4pm a worker pushing a pallet jack loaded with building materials apparently struck a brick wall that had only begun to be laid that day. Bricks scattered and some fell to the level below.

The corporation said it attached great importance to the incident, had instructed the contractor to investigate immediately and submit a detailed report, and had suspended work in the affected area at once.

A social media post circulated after the incident described bricks falling from an upper floor. The writer said a colleague had been standing where the debris landed, heard an unusual sound, looked up and stepped aside as the wall came down. The MTR's account did not name any worker and confirmed there were no injuries.

zh.headline: 東涌東站磚牆被喊車撞倒 港鐵暫停涉事範圍工程
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，承建商指星期六下午4時許工人推載料喊車時疑撞倒剛開始硬建的磚牆，部分磚頭掉至下層，事件無人受傷。
body: 港鐵公司表示，東涌線延線東涌東站建造工地星期六下午發生意外，一幅剛開始硬建的磚牆被撞倒，涉事範圍工程已即時暫停。港鐵稱事件中無人受傷。
港鐵指，承建商報稱約下午4時，有工人推動一部盛載建築物料的喊車時，疑不慎撞倒站內當日剛開始碼建的磚牆，導致磚頭散落，部分掉至下層。
港鐵表示高度重視事件，已責成承辦商立即調查並提交詳細報告，涉事範圍工程同時暫停。
事後有社交平台帖文描述磚塊由高處墜下。發帖者稱同事當時正站在碎塊落點，聽到異響後朝上看見牆身已在墜下，及時走開兩步。港鐵的說明並未提及個別工人身份，並確認無人受傷。
